title: 第5346章 人族援军到第5345章 代价有点大
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：陆沉周若雪第5346章人族援军到（..la）突然，一道强烈的气流从远方传来，冲散了高空上的云层，也冲击了骨族大军的战斗气势。
那不是一般的气流，而是无数虚神气息集结在一起，直冲而来的气息流。
这说明，有一股强大的力量正往这边赶来，注定要介入战场。
而这股强大的力量就是……
“人族！”
“人族的气息！”
“人族的气息流！”
“人族的援军来了！”
那一刻，骨族大军骚动了起来，纷纷转头回望，未见任何人影，只有传来的气息流。
他们知道，那是人族援军还在远方，尚未进入视野的范围，但很快便会到达。
而且，根据气息流的强烈程度来看，人族援军的兵力很多、实力很强，完全不在他们之下，甚至还要在他们之上。
如果真是如此，只要人族援军一到，他们在战场上的优势将荡然无存，甚至还会被人族援军压着打。
更糟糕的是，他们拿不下眼前这十余万的人族大军，还要被更强的人族援军从后方攻击，沦入腹背受敌的险恶境地。
“后军准备迎战，所有人准备两头作战！”
领队的骨族高层大手一挥，命令后军调转方向，以防被人族援军直接打进来。
数十万骨人纷纷转向后方，还在仓促之间摆开防御阵型，等侯人族援军的到来。
与骨族大军的惊慌失措相比，人族大军则是欢呼雀跃，也随之做好了反击的准备，准备在人族援军到来之时，一举打崩骨族大军。
最高兴的人，还不是那些人族战士，而是陆沉和肥龙。
人族高层终于派援军来了，而且援军的实力还很强，打败百万骨族大军没什么问题。
保护入口通道的人族大军，也终于不需要跟骨族大军长时间的打下去了，不用再消耗更多的盾防，这绝对是超级好消息。

肥龙的仙盾库存量，好歹是保住了，不会被打到所剩无几的地步，以后狂热军团好歹还有一定的盾防庇护，不至于连一场战斗都打不起。
其实，以狂热军团强大的整体实力，以及个人的强悍战力，无论什么战斗都打得起，也打得赢。
只是陆沉有一个太逆天的要求，即是不能战死一人，这么一来，那就不是什么战斗都敢打了。
按照这个苛刻标准，军团在没有盾防庇护的情况下，什么战斗都不能打，什么风险都不敢冒，全都乖乖苟起来得了。
若是军团的核心成员还好，个个战力超强，个个有独特的技能，对外同阶无敌的存在，没那么容易被斩。
但军团的五千战士就不行了，他们的战力没有核心成员那么强大，上了战场在劣势的战况之下，谁也无法保证会不会战死。
片刻之后，天空的远方出现一个个小黑点，正往战场这边疾飞而来。
转眼之间，小黑点成倍成倍的增加，如密密麻麻的蝗虫大军，遮掩了半边天空，甚至挡住了阳光透射，给地面上带来一片昏暗。
趁着小黑点越飞越近，也越来越清晰，已经看得见原本的面目，密密麻麻全是人。
果然是人族！
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Lu Chen and Zhou Ruoxue Chapter 5346 Human reinforcements arrive (..la) Suddenly, a strong airflow came from the distance, breaking up the clouds in the sky and impacting the fighting momentum of the Bone Clan army.
That was not an ordinary air flow, but the air flow of countless virtual gods gathering together and rushing straight towards him.
This shows that a powerful force is coming here and is destined to intervene in the battlefield.
And this powerful force is...
"Human race!"
"The breath of human race!"
"The breath flow of the human race!"
"Human reinforcements are coming!"
At that moment, the Bone Clan army became commotion, and they all turned their heads and looked back. No one was seen, only the flow of breath.
They knew that the human reinforcements were still far away and had not yet entered the field of vision, but they would arrive soon.
Moreover, judging from the intensity of the breath flow, the human reinforcements have many troops and are very strong. They are not inferior to them at all, and are even superior to them.
If this is the case, as soon as the human reinforcements arrive, their advantage on the battlefield will be gone, and they will even be suppressed by the human reinforcements.
What's worse is that they can't take down the more than 100,000 human army in front of them, and they have to be attacked from the rear by stronger human reinforcements, falling into a dangerous situation where they are attacked from both sides.
"The rear army is ready to fight, and everyone is ready to fight from both ends!"
The leading Bone Clan executive waved his hand and ordered the rear army to change direction to prevent being directly invaded by human reinforcements.
Hundreds of thousands of skeleton men turned to the rear and hurriedly set up defensive formations, waiting for the arrival of human reinforcements.
Compared with the panic of the Bone Race army, the Human Race army cheered and was ready to counterattack, ready to defeat the Bone Race army in one fell swoop when the Human Race reinforcements arrived.
The happiest people were not the human warriors, but Lu Chen and Fei Long.
The top management of the human race finally sent reinforcements, and the reinforcements were very strong. There would be no problem in defeating the millions of Bone Clan army.
The human army protecting the entrance passage finally no longer needs to fight with the bone army for a long time, and no more shield defense is consumed. This is absolutely great news.
Fat Dragon's immortal shield inventory has been saved at least, and will not be reduced to the point where there is not much left. The Fanatic Legion will still have a certain amount of shield protection in the future, so that it will not be unable to fight even a battle.
In fact, with the strong overall strength of the Zealot Legion and their strong personal combat power, they can fight and win any battle.
It's just that Lu Chen has a very unreasonable requirement, that is, he cannot kill anyone in battle. In this case, he will not dare to fight in any battle.
According to this harsh standard, without the protection of shields, the legion can't fight any battles, dare not take any risks, and all can just be obedient.
It would be fine if they were the core members of the legion. All of them were extremely powerful, had unique skills, and were invincible to the outside world at the same level. They would not be killed so easily.
But the same cannot be said for the five thousand soldiers of the legion. Their combat power is not as strong as the core members. When they go to the battlefield in a disadvantageous battle situation, no one can guarantee whether they will die in battle.
After a while, small black dots appeared in the distance of the sky, flying towards the battlefield.
In the blink of an eye, the small black spots multiplied and multiplied, like a dense army of locusts, covering half of the sky and even blocking the transmission of sunlight, bringing darkness to the ground.
As the little black dot flew closer and closer, it became clearer and clearer, and its original appearance could be seen, densely packed with people.
It is indeed a human race!
